description: Header file defining the hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_WPS class, which provides an interface for Wi-Fi Protected Setup (WPS) parameters and functions related to a Wi-Fi endpoint, including enabling/disabling WPS and retrieving supported/configured methods.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint_WPS
classes.description: Class providing access to WPS-related parameters for a Wi-Fi endpoint, including enabling/disabling WPS and retrieving supported/configured methods.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_WPS_Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables WPS functionality for this end point.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_WPS_ConfigMethodsSupported
methods.description: Retrieves the list of WPS configuration methods supported by the device.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_WPS_ConfigMethodsEnabled
methods.description: Checks which WPS configuration methods are enabled on the device.
